description: Use this when the user wants to write, edit, translate, preview or publish an app's App Store listing: name, subtitle, promotional text, description, keywords, what's new, URLs and screenshots per device and language. Returns the file format the listing keeps in the project (`store.config.json`, the file Expo's metadata command reads, plus a screenshot folder per language and device), Apple's limit for every field, the screenshot sizes each device folder accepts, and the `npx better-design listing` commands that show a live App Store preview, file screenshots by size, and pull from and push to App Store Connect with the user's own key.

context.description: Optional. One sentence on WHY you are calling this and what the user asked for (e.g. 'adding nav icons for the fintech dashboard'). Used only for usage analytics; does not change the result.
